name: Tennessee
summary: Tennessee's official hosts are largely closed to tools: tncourts.gov (all court rules, opinions, Rule 11 lists) serves a browser-validation challenge to both the script and WebFetch, and capitol.tn.gov (General Assembly, constitution PDF) disallows all robots. The official T.C.A. is a LexisNexis JavaScript app, so statutes, constitution and case law fall to Justia (tier 2, WebFetch only; built URLs work). Administrative rules are readable: official SOS chapter PDFs by WebFetch (script refused by a CloudFront 403) and Cornell LII by script. Court rules and Rule 11 dispositions have no free tool-readable source.

citation_map.notes: No law_aliases needed: T.C.A. cites are title-chapter-section and the Justia URL is built from the numbers (part = section // 100). 'T.C.A.'/'TCA' and 'Tenn. Code Ann.' are Tennessee markers; bare '§ 28-3-104' routes here only with 'of the Tennessee Code'. Ranges ('§§ 29-20-201 to -205') capture only the first section. Bare 'Rule 12.02(6)', 'RPC 1.7' and regional S.W. cites are context_required. Docket numbers [EMW]YYYY-NNNNN-(SC|COA|CCA|WC)-… are uniquely Tennessee. Unpublished opinions are cited by docket + WL with a '(Tenn. Ct. App. date)' parenthetical and Rule 11 history ('perm. app. denied'). No public-domain citation format. Special Workers' Compensation Appeals Panel opinions are on Justia under workers-compensation; CourtListener id for that panel not known. The court-parenthetical pattern has negative lookbehinds for 'denied/granted/dismissed/filed ' so 'perm. app. denied (Tenn. …)' routes only to Rule 11 history (independent check 2026-10-17).

access.pattern_rules: From T.C.A. § T-C-S: title = T, chapter = C, section number S as cited; part = integer part of S divided by 100 (104 → 1, 205 → 2, 1307 → 13). For a §§ range use the first section. Year-specific editions: insert /{year}/ after /tennessee/.
access.navigation: On a fetch error or wrong page, navigate: title-{T}/chapter-{C}/ (parts by name only, no section ranges) → part-{P}/ → section link. Always read the edition year on the section page.

access.pattern_rules: Chapter PDFs are publications.tnsosfiles.com/rules/{agency}/{agency-division}/{chapter}.{YYYYMMDD}.pdf; the date suffix is the edition date and is NOT constructible. Agency index pages are publications.tnsosfiles.com/rules/{agency}/{agency}.htm (seen for 1330).
access.navigation: Index navigation cannot reach a chapter PDF with tools: sos.tn.gov/rules-and-regulations lists agency numbers (no hrefs exposed to WebFetch) → agency page publications.tnsosfiles.com/rules/{agency}/{agency}.htm lists DIVISIONS ({agency}-01 …), not chapters, and exposes no hrefs → (division page, unverified) → chapter PDF. The script is refused on this host, so links cannot be extracted. In practice the date-stamped chapter PDF URL comes only from a web search result; otherwise route the citation to tn-admincode-lii first.

access.pattern_rules: court = supreme-court | court-of-appeals | court-of-criminal-appeals | workers-compensation; year = decision year; docket_lower = the docket number lower-cased (M2022-01820-SC-R11-SV → m2022-01820-sc-r11-sv).
